user.title: Connect to VU1 Server
user.description: Select how to connect to your VU1 Server.

manual.title: Manual Configuration
manual.description: Enter the connection details for your VU1 Server. Use the server's master key (master_key in its config.yaml) for full access. A key created in the VU1 Server Web UI under Settings → API Keys works for everything except provisioning new dials.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the machine running VU1 Server.
data_description.api_key: The master key or a VU1 Server API key.

addon.title: VU1 Server Add-on
addon.description: Enter the master key of the VU1 Server add-on. It is printed in the add-on log on every start (restart the add-on if you missed it). A key created in the add-on Web UI under Settings → API Keys works for everything except provisioning new dials.

data_description.api_key: The master key or a VU1 Server API key.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure VU1 Server
reconfigure.description: Update connection settings for your VU1 Server.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the machine running VU1 Server.
data_description.api_key: Leave empty to keep the current key.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with VU1 Server
reauth_confirm.description: Your VU1 Server API key is no longer valid. Enter a new one.

data_description.api_key: The master key or a VU1 Server API key.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to VU1 Server

abort.addon_not_running: The VU1 Server add-on is not running. Start it and try again.

error.value_min_greater_than_max: Minimum value must be less than maximum value
error.image_upload_failed: Failed to upload image to the dial

init.title: VU1 Dials Options
init.description: Configure update interval and dial settings

data_description.update_interval: How often Home Assistant polls VU1 Server for dial status.
data_description.timeout: How long to wait for VU1 Server to answer a request.
data_description.configure_dial: Pick a dial to change its update mode or background image. Leave empty to only save the settings above.

configure_dial.title: Configure {dial_name}
configure_dial.description: Choose what to configure for this dial.

data_description.update_mode: Automatic follows a bound sensor. Manual is set from Home Assistant entities and actions.

data_description.background_image: PNG or JPEG, up to 2 MB. The dial display is 144x200 pixels.

configure_automatic.title: Automatic Mode
configure_automatic.description: Bind a sensor to {dial_name}. Its value is mapped from the range below to 0-100% on the dial.

data_description.bound_entity: The entity whose value drives the needle.
data_description.value_min: The source value shown as 0% on the dial.
data_description.value_max: The source value shown as 100% on the dial.

invalid_auth.message: VU1 Server rejected the API key: {message}

invalid_dial_name.message: VU1 Server dial names must be 3-30 characters using only letters, digits, spaces, `-` and `_`

invalid_image.message: The image must be a PNG or JPEG of at most 2 MB

no_dials_targeted.message: The action target contains no VU1 dials

not_a_dial.message: Device {device_id} is not a VU1 dial

not_local_media.message: {media_content_id} is not a local media file

not_vu1_server.message: Unexpected response from {url}; this does not look like a VU1 Server

provision_requires_master_key.message: Provisioning new dials requires the VU1 Server master key (master_key in its config.yaml). Reconfigure the integration with it

single_dial_only.message: Set dial name accepts only one target dial

value_min_not_less_than_max.message: Minimum value must be less than maximum value

invalid_dial_name.title: Dial name not synced to VU1 Server
invalid_dial_name.description: The dial name "{name}" was kept in Home Assistant only. {error}.

no_dials.title: VU1 Server reports no dials
no_dials.description: VU1 Server returned no dials for the configured API key. Grant the key access to dials in the VU1 Server Web UI, or connect a dial and press Provision new dials on the VU1 Server device (requires the master key).

set_dial_value.name: Set dial value
set_dial_value.description: Sets the needle position of a VU1 dial (0-100%). A dial bound to a sensor in automatic mode is switched to manual.

set_dial_backlight.name: Set dial backlight
set_dial_backlight.description: Sets the RGBW backlight color of a VU1 dial. The backlight light entity offers a color picker instead.

white.name: White
white.description: White channel (0-100%). Keeps the current white level when omitted.

set_dial_name.name: Set dial name
set_dial_name.description: Sets the display name of a single VU1 dial. Only one dial can be targeted at a time. The Home Assistant device is renamed too.

name.name: Name
name.description: The new display name for the dial.

set_dial_image.name: Set dial background image
set_dial_image.description: Sets the background image of a VU1 dial from a PNG or JPEG (up to 2 MB, ideally 144x200) in the Home Assistant media library.

media_content_id.name: Media content
media_content_id.description: The image from the media library to use as the dial background.

reload_dial.name: Reload dial
reload_dial.description: Reloads the hardware configuration and refreshes the information of a VU1 dial.
